title: A Room for the Bell
author: Felix Sterling
blurb: Sable Villalobos, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
